component.name: The Secret World – Forever
component.summary: TSW-Forever launcher for the original The Secret World client

description.p: A native launcher that starts the original The Secret World (2012) client through Wine or Proton, with optional FSR upscaling through gamescope and a guided installation.

The launcher contains no game data. The original installer is downloaded only after your explicit consent and only if its checksum is known; you can also use an installer you obtained yourself or an existing installation.
